journey.name: scan onchain amount to confirm
journey.description:
Verifies that pasting or scanning an on-chain BIP21 request that carries an amount, with enough Savings balance, opens the Confirm screen directly instead of the Amount screen, and that the send completes. The amount is fixed: tapping it on Confirm does not open Amount.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet on regtest with at least 50 000 confirmed sats in Savings, a running synced node, Coin Selection set to Autopilot, and a regtest address the wallet does not own. Start on the wallet home screen.
iOS: the simulator has no camera, so set the clipboard with xcrun simctl pbcopy <device> and use Paste Invoice inside Send.

actions.action: Copy "bitcoin:<test recipient address>?amount=0.0001" to the simulator clipboard
Tap the Send button (id "Send"), and if a camera permission dialog appears, choose "Don't Allow"
Verify the Confirm screen (id "SendConfirm") is visible without passing through the Send amount screen (id "SendAmount")
Tap Show Details (id "SendConfirmToggleDetails") and verify the recipient address (id "ReviewUri") and a non-zero network fee are shown
Tap the review amount (id "ReviewAmount-primary") and verify the Confirm screen (id "SendConfirm") stays open with 10 000 and the Send amount screen (id "SendAmount") does not open
Swipe the send handle (id "GRAB") fully to the right, then tap Yes, Send (id "DialogConfirm") if a confirmation dialog appears
Wait for the success screen (id "SendSuccess") and verify it shows 10 000 sats
Run xcrun simctl openurl <device> "bitcoin:<test recipient address>?amount=0.000005"
Verify the Amount Too Low toast (id "AmountTooLowToast") says the minimum is 547 sats, and neither the Send amount screen (id "SendAmount") nor the Confirm screen (id "SendConfirm") opens
